title: Roof Inspection Form
subtitle: Residential Roof Inspection: documents findings, limits, and disposition.
description: Roof Inspection Form covers roof covering, flashing, penetration, drainage edge, attic indicator, and affected interior area. The roof inspection coordinator records Residential Roof Inspection criteria, findings, restrictions, and follow-up. Roof Inspection Form keeps Residential Roof Inspection exceptions visible until the roof inspection coordinator handoff.
use_case: Use Roof Inspection Form at residence, roof plane, edge, penetration, attic area, and reported leak zone. Document roof covering, flashing, penetration, drainage edge, attic indicator, and affected interior area identity before Residential Roof Inspection begins. Compare roof covering, flashing, penetration, drainage edge, attic indicator, and affected interior area findings with stated Residential Roof Inspection criteria; route unresolved Residential Roof Inspection issues to qualified roofing reviewer. For Roof Inspection Form, confirm requirements for Residential Roof Inspection. Ask qualified roofing reviewer to review Residential Roof Inspection conditions beyond the roof inspection coordinator's role.

sections.title: Inspection findings and condition evidence

blocks.label: Residential Roof Inspection points
items: Covering wear, displacement, breakage, and fastening indication
Flashing, valley, penetration, wall, and transition condition
Ridge, edge, gutter, downspout, and drainage path
Sealant, membrane, coating, and visible repair condition
Attic, deck, insulation, staining, and moisture indication
Ground or limited-access observation and unobserved scope
blocks.guidance: Classify every required Residential Roof Inspection point for roof covering, flashing, penetration, drainage edge, attic indicator, and affected interior area as checked, not inspected, inaccessible, or deficient.

columns.label: Pass, issue, N/A, or not inspected

sections.title: Deficiencies, limitations, and corrective action
sections.guidance: Do not pass unobserved Residential Roof Inspection scope; name the affected area and next action.

blocks.label: Findings requiring hold, restriction, or prompt review
items: Unsafe slope, weather, surface, ladder, or edge condition
Active structural movement or collapse concern
Concealed moisture extent cannot be determined
Temporary protection or qualified escalation needed
blocks.guidance: Pause Residential Roof Inspection and notify roof inspection coordinator when safe access, weather, structural stability, water entry, or required qualified assessment remains unresolved.
